title: Pink-haired Warrior Poses
description: Four identical side-by-side panels show a young female warrior with bright pink hair in twin tails and a small crown. She wears dark green and black armor with a green cape, gloves, and boots, standing in a dynamic combat stance while blowing a pink bubblegum bubble against a solid lime green background.
prompt: A cartoon female warrior with voluminous bright pink hair in high twin tails and a small crown, blowing a large pink bubblegum bubble. She wears detailed dark green and black fantasy armor with puffy green shoulder pads, a flowing green cape, gloves, and heavy boots. Dynamic combat stance with one leg forward and arms ready for action, shown in four identical panels side by side on a solid lime green background, clean digital illustration style.
